'''Jamie White''' was an InfoWars employee known for his work as a writer and commentator, particularly in relation to conspiracy theories and controversial topics. White contributed articles and appeared in segments that align with the themes and perspectives popularized by Jones and Infowars.

White's work on Infowars has drawn criticism from those who label the platform's content as extremist and misleading. Supporters, however, regard White as a figure who challenges mainstream narratives and offers alternative viewpoints. 

== Homicide ==
On Sunday, March 9, 2025, at approximately 11:56 p.m, Austin PD were called to the scene of a shooting and found Mr. White had been shot. He was pronounced deceased about 20 minutes later at the hospital. It appears Jamie approached someone or some people attempting to rob his car and he was shot in the interaction. In true InfoWars fashion, Alex and the crew wasted no time in claiming it was a Ukrainian hit squad and Alex or Elon were the intended targets. A string of alleged swatting incidents then ensued to crewmembers.
